charts.title: K2-102 b: orbits around K2-102
charts.description: The orbits of K2-102's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-102 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mann et al. 2017 (2017AJ....153...64M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MANN_ET_AL__2017): P 9.915615 d

charts.title: K2-102 b: its transit
charts.description: K2-102 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 175262071, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 334 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 1457 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 11-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 334 min early; 11-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 486 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
